what: Andrew (via coordinator): the front end semantic hash is now Unison-style anonymous (no local/param/generic/item names, no positions; docs/v2/plan/design/item-hash.md 3.3, 3.7). Names and locations reaching the output stay exactly rustc: debuginfo variable names, symbol names, panic Location / line!/column!/file! / #[track_caller] constants. Please key those in codegen by the new presentation hash (blaze_item_hash::presentation(db, def), being added by item-hash-facts) separately from the code hash, so a rename or move reruns only that layer (debuginfo, symbols, location constants), never MIR codegen of the body, and the binary is byte-identical to a fresh build. Check whether any codegen cache key (dev template, code hash) currently includes debuginfo names or line numbers; split them out. item-hash-mir is making MIR records hold location constants as slots filled from the current db on decode.
